text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see! So you want to make French 
pastries♪

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That's right! The pastries I saw the other 
day at that French specialty dessert shop 
were just so pretty and cute!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, wanting to make it just because it's 
cute— that's truly an adventurous spirit!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
My dad taught me how to make quite a few 
pastries. What do you feel like making?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hhhmmm, macarons or madeleines... I can't 
decide!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, having trouble deciding? At times 
like this...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, smiling and listening right 
beside us! Which one do you think is 
better?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
By the way, macarons are notoriously 
difficult to make, often called the 
hardest challenge in pastry making. Though 
Bubble-chan could probably whip them up 
effortlessly!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Madeleines, on the other hand, are pretty 
easy. Because they're so simple, there is 
a knack to it, but I'm sure you can make 
some really great ones!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thanks for backing me up, Laurel.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'll share some with you once it's done, 
so tell me which one you want, Trainer! No 
matter how hard it is, I'll make sure it 
turns out great!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for deciding! —Yup, my mind is made 
up. I'm counting on you, Chef Laurel!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Good luck, Chef Bubble! Alright then, 
let's go to the dorm kitchen~!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I see, so the key is "macaronage," mixing 
the meringue and batter together properly. 
All right, in that case...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I declare it here and now. I'll master the 
macaronage and bake the cutest, most 
delicious macarons ever!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
There it is, Bubble-chan's declaration! I 
have a feeling some amazing macarons are 
coming up♪

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, leave it to me! Now then, first we 
beat the egg whites until stiff peaks 
form...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, after five hours of struggling—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I did iiit~~!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Waaahhhh~!! So cuuuute~!! So round~~!! So 
colorful~~!! Ahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I knew you could do it, but this is 
brilliant! The shape is super neat—you 
could totally sell this in a store!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That's because you're such a great 
teacher, Laurel! Hehe, let me take a bite 
right away—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
*chomp*, mmm~~~~~!! The crust is crispy 
and flaky!! And the chocolate ganache is 
so sweet and melts right in my mouth~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, this is seriously delicious!? Making 
something this good on your first try 
means you're a genius!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, to think I could make something this 
cute and delicious all by myself! It feels 
like I'm dreaming♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
So exciting~! Ah—fufu, looks like everyone 
was lured over by the delicious smell♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, these look delightful to 
accompany our tea time. Which famous shop 
are these macarons from?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—What a lovely aroma. Could I have one, 
please?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Looks good――...What a beautiful 
masterpiece. I would like some... shared 
with me too."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
*Gulp*... If possible, may I have some 
too? Would that be alright?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The line of people waiting for the store 
to open keeps getting longer. What are we 
gonna do, Chef Bubble?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Well, of course, open it right now!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, come on, there's plenty, so dig 
in! Let's all have a sweet party 
together!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Bubble Gum Fellow's cue, the Miho 
Dormitory girls who had gathered reached 
for the mountain of macarons one after 
another.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before long, most of the dorm's Umamusume 
had gathered in the lobby, thoroughly 
enjoying her macarons that could rival any 
bakery's.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for deciding! —Yup, my mind is made 
up. I'm counting on you, Chef Laurel!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Good luck, Chef Bubble! Alright then, 
let's go to the dorm kitchen~!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
So a macaron's crispy crust is made by 
mixing meringue and flour together. I see, 
I see~.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Just looking at recipes is so much fun 
with all the new discoveries! Alright, 
shall we get started?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yeah! First, whisk the egg whites—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, just like that! First, whisk 
until stiff peaks form! Once you add the 
flour, switch to a spatula and...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, after five hours of struggling—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! Such perfection for a first timer! 
You've got a real knack for this, 
Bubble-chan!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
The shape got a little messed up, but I'm 
pretty proud of how it turned out!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"That's what you call 'character.' 
Honestly, I love that it feels handmade!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, absolutely! Now then, how does it 
taste—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
*chomp*, mmm~~~~~!! The crust is crispy 
and flaky!! And the chocolate ganache is 
so sweet and melts right in my mouth~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, this is seriously delicious!? The 
flavor is good enough to serve at a 
restaurant!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for teaching me, Laurel! Making 
macarons by myself feels like a dream come 
true♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Likewise! Ah—hehe, looks like everyone was 
lured over by the aroma♪

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, macarons!! Hey, hey, where did you 
get these? I wanna eat some!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I thought they were awful colorful steamed 
buns at first, but turns out they're 
"macaroons"! Mighty pretty, ain't they~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! It's piled up like a mountain, so 
pretty! Um, may I have some too?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Sweets are my absolute favorite!! If 
you're offering, I will gladly accept!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The line of people waiting for the store 
to open keeps getting longer. What are we 
gonna do, Chef Bubble?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Well, of course, open it right now!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, come on, there's plenty, so dig 
in! Let's all have a sweet party 
together!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Bubble Gum Fellow's cue, the Miho 
Dormitory girls who had gathered reached 
for the mountain of macarons one after 
another.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before long, a crowd of Umamusume gathered 
in the lobby, eagerly relishing Bubble Gum 
Fellow's homemade macarons.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for deciding! Well then, Laurel, 
could you take care of it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay! Alright then, let's go to the dorm 
kitchen!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, I see! I've pretty much got what 
we need to do!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
As expected, you're a fast learner! The 
butter is brought to room temperature, and 
the flour is sifted. Let's mix them in 
order!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Got it! First, beat the eggs—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"It's nicely softened now! Next, we add 
the white caster sugar and honey..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, after three hours of struggling—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: It's doooone!! Waaah, it's so cuuute!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Turned out so cute! The shape is nice, 
too—full marks plus a flower stamp for 
you!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks! It's all because your 
coaching was so great, Laurel!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It's completely cooled down now, so let's 
take a bite right away—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
*chomp*, mmm~~~~~!! Crispy on the outside, 
fluffy on the inside! It's so good~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, this is seriously delicious!? It's 
hard to believe this is your first time 
making it!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I'm amazed I could make something this 
delicious and cute all by myself! It was 
pretty easy, too, so I might want to make 
it again!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Just let me know whenever you want to 
borrow the molds! Ah—fufu, looks like 
everyone was drawn over by the sweet 
aroma♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! Seashell pastries, desu~! Could 
these be fresh out of the oven~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I wondered what was being baked in the 
kitchen, and it turns out they're 
madeleines! Hehe, they look so 
delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, what do we have here! Ain't that 
some fancy-lookin' sweets! Mind sharin' 
one with me?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I used to make madeleines for my little 
sisters too! So nostalgic~♪ Could I have a 
taste?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The line of people waiting for the store 
to open keeps getting longer. What are we 
gonna do, Chef Bubble?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Well, of course, open it right now!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, come on, there's plenty, so dig 
in! Let's all have a sweet party 
together!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Bubble Gum Fellow's cue, the Miho 
Dormitory girls who had gathered reached 
for the mountain of madeleines one after 
another.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before long, a crowd of Umamusume gathered 
in the lobby, eagerly relishing Bubble Gum 
Fellow's homemade madeleines.
